stages.label: Requests arrive
stages.narrative: Modeled requests and returns change each hub's available cable inventory.

stages.label: Shortages form
stages.narrative: Local inventory gaps reveal which cable families cannot be served in place.

stages.label: Network rebalances
stages.narrative: Exact min-cost allocation moves available cables toward unresolved requests.

stages.label: Month settles
stages.narrative: Fulfillment, transfer burden, and remaining inventory close against the local-only branch.
